simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עַכְשׁוּב (H5919) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: עַכְשׁוּב (ʻakshûwb) means an asp (from lurking coiled up) First listed occurrence: Ps 140 4.

definitions.full: H5919. akshub עַכְשׁוּב noun masculine usually asp, viper (so ᵑ9 ᵐ5 ; perhaps conject. from sense and || נָחָשׁ ), but perhaps = (? corrupt for) עַכָּבִישׁ spider (q. v.; compare ᵑ7 on the passage ); — ע ׳חֲמַת Psa 140:4 a viper's (? spider's) venom is under their lips (see especially Che and references). עַל see עֹל עלה see III. עלל .
definitions.rootNote: probably from an unused root meaning to coil ;
